host_pcb_constraints_summary: Differential CK / WCK / RDQS matched-length routing with tight intra-pair skew at 6400+ Mbit/s; impedance-controlled differential traces.
7-bit CA bus + CS routing length-matched to CK; single-ended low-power-swing referenced to Vref(ca).
Per-byte-lane DQ / DMI routing matched to WCK / RDQS; impedance-controlled single-ended traces referenced to Vref(dq).
On-die termination (ODT) + receiver DFE / tx-rx equalization replace external DQ/DQS termination; ODT values set per mode register.
VDDQ regulated to 0.5 V with low-noise decoupling; VDD1 (~1.8 V) and VDD2H/VDD2L core supplies with DVFSC voltage-domain switching.
ZQ external precision reference resistor to ground per device.
Supply ramp sequencing: VDD1 → VDD2H/VDD2L → VDDQ before RESET_n deassertion.
Soldered / PoP mechanical attach (no DIMM connector); package ballout per JESD209-5; mobile form-factor SI budget.
Vref(ca) / Vref(dq) internally generated and trimmed per frequency set point; board provides clean supplies for the on-die reference generators.
fields.dram_internal_constraints: DRAM-die-internal PDK, SDC, and layout constraints (including the on-die WCK clock generator / DLL/PLL, DFE, sense-amp bias, charge pumps) are vendor-specific (mobile DRAM process at the LPDDR5 generation, sub-20 nm-class) and intentionally out of scope. Internal cell-array trim and redundancy repair are not exposed at the bus interface.
fields.notes: JESD209-5 standardizes electrical AC/DC parameters at the package balls but no internal PDK / floorplan / SDC content. LPDDR5 controller and PHY IP from vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, SoC vendors) ship their own SDC + UPF + DFT files tailored to specific PDK nodes and mobile SoC integration scenarios. The distinguishing electrical constraint versus DDR3 is the 0.5 V VDDQ and the per-frequency-set-point Vref / DVFSC voltage scaling, plus the on-demand WCK clock requiring WCK2CK leveling/training in the PHY.
